Rose Lok Collection

  • English
  • 简体中文
  • 繁體中文

collection

This is a collection of materials that concern Rose Lok and the Chinese Patriotic Flying Corps. Several items involve Lok's co-pilots and other special interviews. Also included are emails explaining how the collection came to be in the possession of CHSNE.
